gaps.title: No blog / editorial content
gaps.why: Freshness cliff at ~3 months. Confirmed again 2026-09-11: content depth + freshness remain the dominant differentiator against blog-post-heavy competitors like osteopath-christchurch.com (headaches / migraine / cranial / baby / arthritis), MK Osteopathy (TMJ), headachetendon.nz (chiropractor #1 on 'lower back pain christchurch' for 3+ weeks — DISPLACED THIS WEEK by betterhealthosteopathy.nz/back-pain-relief-osteopath-christchurch/, dropping to #4), and now triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz's cross-body-region expansion into arthritis / back-pain / neck-pain / concussion / pregnancy via dedicated landing URLs. Meridian's Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure (PR #108) is the closest thing we have to blog cadence — one entry per month, homepage-surface only, not a separate URL. Item #14 covers the full blog build. **STRONGEST EVIDENCE YET FOR URL-PER-CONDITION 2026-09-11**: Meridian's /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ URL now ranks on TWO distinct queries — #4 on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch' (2nd consecutive week) AND #5 on 'pregnancy pelvic pain christchurch' (first check ranks immediately, on a query added only last run). A single well-structured condition URL is now producing cross-query authority, not just single-query rank. The blog would multiply this — 10 condition/topic URLs, each capable of ranking on 2-3 adjacent-intent queries, is a very different visibility surface than the current 6. **AND**: the Zyppy 2026 Ranking Factors Survey (Sept 9, 131 SEOs, 103 signals, 13,665 data points) confirmed top 3 signals are search-intent match + backlinks (trusted+topical) + content quality — the exact three that a schema-first, brand-page-heavy site cannot compete on but a topical-blog can.

items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. DOWNWEIGHTED 2026-08-07: Ahrefs schema-impact study (+2.4% AI Mode / +2.2% ChatGPT / –4.6% AIO across 1,885 pages) held up in late-July commentary; consensus is schema is a context signal, not a lever. Speakable specifically has been in beta 7 years without leaving beta. REINFORCED 2026-09-04: Ahrefs' 1,885-page schema study finalised — no major uplift in AI citations across Google AI Overviews / AI Mode / ChatGPT. The Feb 2026 Fischman study (730 AI citations, 75 commercial queries, health included) found dominant predictor of AI citation is Google organic rank position: position-1 pages cited in 43% of queries. **REINFORCED AGAIN 2026-09-11**: Zyppy 2026 Ranking Factors Expert Survey (Sept 9, 131 SEOs, 103 signals, 13,665 data points) put schema markup outside the top 3 signals — top 3 are search-intent match, backlinks (trusted + topical sites), content quality. Even meta description ranked effectively zero-impact. Speakable does not appear on any top-signal list this year. Keep on the list because it's still cheap, but do NOT invest engineering time in schema-type expansion over body-copy / condition-page / blog work.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report now names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor (reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month per Epicware July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend, so review freshness feeds both the Local Pack AND the AI-citation layer. Combined with #16, this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-04: no new counter-signal. **CAVEAT ADDED 2026-09-11 — GBP INSIGHTS OUTAGE**: Barry Schwartz / SE Roundtable reported 2026-09-08 that GBP Insights had 8+ days of the month with zero data; unresolved through 2026-09-11. Backfill expected but not delivered. This doesn't block the review-count fetch itself (Places API vs Insights are different endpoints) but the build script SHOULD be resilient to Places-API blob outages: (a) treat 429 / 5xx as soft-fail and reuse the cached values from the last successful fetch, (b) don't fail the Netlify build if the API is unreachable, (c) surface stale-cache warnings in the build log so a persistent outage isn't invisible. Also: don't read September Discovery vs Direct movement in weekly-audit/ship-it output until Google backfills — flag the gap, don't score a false dip.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
files: PR #108 Practitioner Spotlight infra can be extended rather than a from-scratch build
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. **STRONGEST EVIDENCE YET 2026-09-11**: Meridian's /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ URL now ranks on TWO distinct queries this week — #4 on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch' (2nd consecutive week) AND #5 on 'pregnancy pelvic pain christchurch' (first check ranks immediately, on a query added only last run to test whether the URL generalises). This is decisive evidence for the URL-per-condition thesis: a single well-structured condition URL is producing cross-query authority, not just single-query rank. Combined with the tennis-elbow-osteopath-christchurch #9 rank via /conditions/sports-injury-recovery/ (FOURTH consecutive week — most durable rank on the board), and the Zyppy 2026 Ranking Factors Expert Survey (Sept 9, 131 SEOs) putting search-intent match + trusted/topical backlinks + content quality as the top 3 signals, the case for a scaled blog build is stronger than ever. STARTING POINT: PR #108's Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure — the Decap collection config, JSON-LD, homepage surface and image handling can be adapted rather than built from scratch. Consensus in late-Aug commentary: depth > velocity — 2 posts/month is fine if each is genuinely useful. AI Overviews respond to 68% of local searches now; position-1 organic CTR fell from 1.41% to 0.64% on pages where an AIO appears (Ahrefs, -54% effective drop) — traditional-organic-only strategy is losing yield, so the AI-citation angle matters even more.

Perplexity's Reddit share (~24% of tracked citations; ~46.7% of Perplexity's OWN citations point at Reddit; 82% of cited content <30 days old) unchanged. Reddit-seeding for Perplexity-visibility is the recommended primary lever; ChatGPT-Reddit is dead for now. **NEW DATAPOINT 2026-09-11**: OpenAI Deep Research shipped into ChatGPT Work + Codex on 2026-09-09 with cited, editable outputs across web/files/connected apps for Pro/Enterprise/Edu first — more consumers will run cited 'compare-osteo-clinics-in-Christchurch'-style research where an off-site brand mention on Reddit / a directory / a local news outlet is the citation surface. Reinforces this item as the highest-leverage off-site AI-visibility play. ClaudeBot overtook GPTBot at 16.28% vs 9.74% (Cloudflare July 2026 baseline) — Reddit-in-Claude is a separate open question. **The time-decay clock is running**: Perplexity motion to dismiss the Reddit scraping suit was rejected 31 Jul; Reddit/Google $60M/yr licensing renewal talks stalled; the ChatGPT-Reddit collapse this window is one instance of that decay playing out. If Reddit tightens access to Perplexity too, this lever narrows further. Recommend acting in the next 30-60 days. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge + personalised response SLA
items.body: Post-consultation email nudge via Resend (already wired). AI engines prefer reviews under 12 months old. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor. Reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month (Epicware / DigitalApplied July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend — freshness now compounds across Local Pack AND AI citation. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end. UPDATED 2026-09-04 — response-cadence discipline added: Whitespark 2026 now tracks owner response within 48 hours as a separate behavioral signal (89% of consumers expect businesses to respond to reviews; 81% expect a reply within a week; next-day expectations climbed to 32% from 18% a year ago). BrightLocal 2026 consumer survey: 50% of consumers are actively put off by generic or templated review responses. Recommendation refined: (a) same-week response as a hard floor, (b) 24-48hr target for freshness weight, (c) response text must be PERSONALISED (name the specific practitioner or treatment the reviewer mentioned; avoid template language). AI-Mode local pack now often shows 1-2 businesses instead of 3 (Sterling Sky tracking) — fewer slots means the response-rate + recency signals matter more relative to a broader 3-slot pack. The nudge template should include a hand-off note on the clinic side to reply promptly AND personally. No new research 2026-09-11 — baseline holds.

items.title: Build an /acc/ landing page — Active Health / Better Health own the dedicated-URL slot
items.body: Active Health owns 'osteopath acc christchurch' at #1 (re-checked 2026-09-11); House of Acupuncture owns 'acupuncture acc christchurch'. **NEW DIRECT PRECEDENT 2026-09-11**: on this run's re-check of 'osteopath acc christchurch', betterhealthosteopathy.nz/acc/ appears at #5 — a dedicated, single-URL, /acc/ landing page has now been shipped by the closest osteopathy competitor and Google is indexing it into the top 5. This directly validates item #25's URL structure: a single /acc/ URL is the right shape, not scattered ACC mentions across service pages. We have ACC pricing scattered across the site but no single indexable /acc/ URL. PR #113 rewrote all site-wide ACC copy from 'we lodge claims for you' to 'ACC-registered provider' framing after Google Ads disapproved the clinic under the 'Government documents and official services' policy — the /acc/ page must follow the same discipline. Describe (a) that Meridian is an ACC-registered treatment provider (osteopathy — Nina Hu; acupuncture — Min Jin); (b) the current ACC subsidy amount and what a patient pays out-of-pocket; (c) that no referral is required to book; (d) an explicit non-affiliation line with a link to acc.co.nz (matches PR #113's disclaimer for the manual Ads-review reviewer). Do NOT describe the mechanics of claim filing on the patient's behalf. Passage-level extraction still matters (88% of health queries trigger AI Overview, 83% zero-click per July 2026 SEJ healthcare-AI data) — a tight 40–60 word intro block per item #31's pattern should lead the page.

items.title: Add /conditions/concussion/ page — Triskelion + Better Health (now practitioner-level) own the SERP
items.body: First check 2026-05-22 of 'concussion osteopath christchurch' showed triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz at #1, osteo.co.nz/concussion/ at #2, triskelionosteopathy.co.nz/concussion/ at #3. Reinforced 2026-06-05 and 2026-08-07: same dominant Triskelion + Better Health + osteo.co.nz + Moorhouse + HeadWise + Halswell set. 2026-08-14: SERP CHURN — osteo.co.nz took #1 back from triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz. **RE-CHECKED 2026-09-11 (deferred from last run) — NEW #1 IS A PRACTITIONER PROFILE PAGE**: betterhealthosteopathy.nz/anastasia-mcpherson-osteopath-christchurch/ has taken #1 on 'concussion osteopath christchurch'. This is a new SERP pattern — competitors now index at PRACTITIONER-LEVEL for concussion intent, not just condition/service pages. osteo.co.nz/concussion/ dropped to #2; Triskelion still holds multiple top-5 slots. This changes item #32's implementation calculus: alongside a dedicated /conditions/concussion/ page, Nina's team profile (and/or Maddison's, given her cranial work) should surface concussion intent explicitly in the What-I-Treat chips + a paragraph in her About section — that gives Google TWO indexable Meridian URLs for concussion intent (the condition page + a practitioner page), matching the two-URL competitor pattern Better Health has just proven works. Concussion is high-value, ACC-adjacent injury content (post-concussion symptoms — headaches, dizziness, fatigue, brain fog — overlap directly with headache/migraine and neck pain conditions we already treat). **Triskelion is now expanding across body-region queries** — this week showed triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz #1 on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch' and #3 on 'pregnancy pelvic pain christchurch'. Their brand is spreading beyond concussion, which makes the case for a defensive Meridian concussion page more urgent, not less. The smallest fix is a /conditions/concussion/ page mirroring the existing pattern (sciatica, neck-pain, back-pain, headaches-migraines, pregnancy-back-pain, sports-injury-recovery): MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro (per #31's pattern), structured 5–7 item list blocks (per #34's pattern), acute-vs-chronic / when-to-seek-urgent-care / ACC eligibility (matching PR #113's provider-status framing) / how osteopathy fits / book-now sections. Add corresponding entry to conditions.json (including the `lists` array structure introduced in #34) and a tile in the homepage 'Common conditions we treat' grid. **The pregnancy-back-pain URL's cross-query rank this run is direct precedent** — condition-page URLs with the full pattern rank AND generalise.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report + capture baseline
items.body: Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode, broken down by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity. UPDATED 2026-08-14 — BASELINE CORRECTION: the report is STILL impressions-only — no CTR, no clicks, no query data (per Aug 2026 write-ups from Pragma-Code, Weblumino, TJ Robertson, SmartTeam). The report is still worth enabling (AI-surface impressions remain the only first-party AI-visibility signal we can get), but the end-to-end 'AI-surface → click → booking' attribution story pairs with the STANDARD Performance report's existing CTR column, not the Gen AI panel — until Google actually ships CTR there. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-11: no new news on Gen-AI-panel CTR through this window; the panel remains impressions-only. **CAVEAT**: GBP Insights is currently in a September outage (Barry Schwartz / SE Roundtable reported 2026-09-08, unresolved through 2026-09-11) — this doesn't directly affect the GSC Gen AI report (different product, different backend) but it's a reminder that Google's local-analytics stack has data-freshness gaps and any baseline captured now should be screenshot-preserved rather than relied on as always-available. The opt-out toggle went live 2026-06-17 (~13 weeks ago); since properties are opt-in by default, the report should still be capturing unless explicitly disabled. Action items: (1) verify meridianosteopathy.co.nz is a verified property in the clinic's GSC account, (2) confirm the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle is still ON, (3) screenshot the report's default 3-month window as a 'pre-blog' baseline (~3 months of data now available) before item #14 ships, (4) build the AI-surface-attribution story on Performance-report CTR paired with the GA4 booking_completed event added in PR #116, NOT on a Gen-AI-panel CTR column that does not yet exist. Use the SEJ CTR-loss diagnostic framing ('stable rankings + stable impressions + falling CTR = AI Overview click loss') against the standard Performance report as a diagnostic overlay against the Gen AI impression trend for the same URL set. No code changes needed.

items.title: Add a postpartum recovery section or dedicated /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ page — thin SERP opportunity
items.body: First-run check 2026-08-14 of 'postpartum osteopath christchurch' returned only 6 total Google results. Third check 2026-09-11 CONFIRMS the thin-SERP pattern holds and is intensifying: Google returned ~6 results, 4 of which are Better Health URLs (pregnancy, care/postnatal, care/pregnancy, main); osteo.co.nz + osteopath-christchurch.com round out the top 6. Better Health is aggressively consolidating this thin-SERP query with a URL-per-life-stage strategy. A hollow SERP that a targeted page could rank on with minimal effort. **STRONGEST-EVIDENCE-YET ARGUMENT 2026-09-11**: our /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ URL now ranks on TWO pregnancy queries — #4 on 'pregnancy back pain' + #5 on 'pregnancy pelvic pain' (first-check). This is direct precedent that the condition-page pattern works on pregnancy / perinatal intent AND generalises across adjacent queries. A /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ page shares the same audience and would benefit from adjacent-page internal-link authority. Two implementation options: (a) EXTEND — add a 'Postpartum recovery' H2 section to the existing /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ page with US-spelling variants in body copy (postpartum, postnatal, post-birth) and appropriate MedicalCondition JSON-LD updates, keeping single-page authority (RISK: the pregnancy-back-pain page is now the site's most productive URL — do NOT dilute its focus); or (b) NEW PAGE — /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ following the standard condition-page pattern (MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro per #31, structured list blocks per #34), separate URL to catch the exact-slug search intent. Option (b) is MORE strongly indicated given the pregnancy-back-pain URL's cross-query ranking success — do not risk that URL's focus, ship a fresh URL instead. Add a tile to the homepage 'Common conditions we treat' grid. Effort S.

items.title: Monthly GBP contributor-photo audit — defend against phone-in-photo scam
files: (GBP console — no repo changes; add to a monthly clinic checklist)
items.body: Barry Schwartz / SE Roundtable flagged 2026-09-10 a new Google Maps scam where bad actors upload AI-generated 'contributor' photos to a target Business Profile containing fraudulent phone numbers overlaid on plausible clinic-interior imagery. Google's system sometimes surfaces these contributor images in the profile's photo carousel, and a viewer scanning for a phone number can dial the scam number instead of the real one. Defensive action: monthly check Meridian's Business Profile → Photos → Contributor tab (or 'By others'), scan every image for anything showing a phone number, email address, URL, or business hours that isn't ours; flag any suspect image via the GBP photo-report flow. Also worth spot-checking that Google Maps still surfaces our real number as the tap-to-call target on mobile and that any recent contributor uploads look legitimate (Google's contributor imagery is un-moderated at upload — this is a manual-review-after-the-fact system, which is what the scam exploits). Low effort (~5-10 mins/month), zero code changes, purely a clinic-side ops item — but the failure mode is patients calling a scammer instead of the clinic, so worth doing.
